title: SPD and U.S. Marshals Announce Completion of Operation Orange
summary: Syracuse Police Department and U.S. Marshals Service completed Operation Orange (May 11–July 10, 2026), a sex offender registry compliance enforcement initiative that conducted 100+ residential compliance checks, identified 85 noncompliant individuals, and issued arrest warrants. The operation improved registry accuracy and demonstrated federal-local law enforcement collaboration on public safety.

political_signal.description: Mayor and Police Chief jointly champion public safety initiative; emphasis on federal-local collaboration and registry accuracy as community protection measure.
